summary: This 8-K filing by Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. reports routine April 2026 cash distributions paid on multiple classes of common stock (Classes G, G-D, G-S, E, I) on May 14, 2026 to holders of record as of April 30, 2026. Distributions range from $0.1730 to $0.1900 per share after servicing fees for certain classes. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. This is a routine operational update with no triggering special-situation classification under the specified categories.
